name: Hu tieu with pate
summary: Breakfast hủ tiếu comes with a pork-pâté slice of pig-head skin, pork fat, lean pork, and pepper, chewy, crisp at the edge, and a little rich. The dinner bowl of the same noodle is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro.
origin: Ben Tre town. The breakfast bowl has a pork-pâté slice. The dinner bowl is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. They are not the same bowl.
texture: The slice is dai giòn and beo béo: chewy, crisp at the edge, and rich. That is that counter’s slice, not the quail-egg bowl.
howToEat: Eat the pâté slice at breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4. Do not fold it into the dinner bowl.
The dinner bowl is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. A 9 June 2021 account also names wonton, seafood, and pork-and-bone bowls at the same counter. Those are not the pâté bowl.
where: Đường 30 Tháng 4 for the breakfast slice.
